name: feature-delivery
description: Kiro SDD full-lifecycle feature delivery workflow: requirements, design, wave-based tasks, implementation, and verification

steps.prompt: Scaffold feature specification for '{{inputs.name}}' in domain '{{inputs.domain}}' with title '{{inputs.title}}'. Run `npm run spec:new -- --name {{inputs.name}} --domain {{inputs.domain}} --title "{{inputs.title}}" --type feature`.

Refine docs/specs/{{inputs.domain}}/{{inputs.name}}/brief.json. Formulate strict EARS 5-state requirements (Ubiquitous, Event, State, Unwanted, Optional) without ambiguity. Run `npm run spec:build -- --name {{inputs.name}}`.

Review and enhance docs/specs/{{inputs.domain}}/{{inputs.name}}/design.md. Verify domain boundary in packages/plugins/plugin-{{inputs.domain}}, ensure 8 audit columns, multi-tenant isolation, and define cross-domain Domain Facade contracts.

Review tasks.md dependency graph. Ensure tasks are organized into Kiro Waves (Wave 1: Contracts/Tables/RedTest, Wave 2: Service Implementation, Wave 3: Verification & Gates). White-list exact files per task.
Implement the waves sequentially following 1 Task = 1 Commit. Reuse BaseMapper<T> and QueryWrapper, strictly zero console.log and zero duplicate CRUD.
Run full test matrix and quality gates. Verify with `npm run check && npm run test:matrix`. Confirm 0 lint errors, 0 fake mocks, and 100% exit code 0.
